description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notice of Amendment that Regulation "D"made by the Monetary Board and published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1805/39 of 12.04.2013 w.e.f. 16.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to banking regulations (Regulation "D" on Reserve Requirements) made under the Monetary Law Act by the Monetary Board of Sri Lanka. It involves regulatory changes to financial institution requirements, specifically modifying reserve percentages and reporting formats for deposit liabilities. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for financial institutions.
